description: Script for managing and creating directory structures for roadmaps content, including validation of roadmap IDs, directory tree preparation, and filesystem operations to generate content directories and files.

methods.name: prepareDirTree
methods.description: Recursively processes control objects to build a directory tree and sort order mappings based on control properties.

methods.name: createDirTree
methods.description: Recursively creates directory structure and content files based on the directory tree and sort orders.
